dataset_title: SOET VeriTrust Controlled Synthetic ELA Forensic Evaluation Manifest
disclaimer: Controlled synthetic evaluation set for empirical Error Level Analysis (ELA) research. Does not use real student data. Does not establish general clinical/forensic accuracy. Merkle proof verification remains the sole authoritative source of academic degree authenticity.

samples.modification_method: Single-pass headless browser render to bitmap, compressed once as JPEG.
samples.evaluation_notes: Clean baseline representing high-quality single-pass export. Uniform compression history across all 8x8 DCT grid blocks. Expected ELA result: LOW ANOMALY / baseline variance.

samples.modification_method: Single-pass headless browser render to bitmap, compressed once as JPEG at standard ELA quality.
samples.evaluation_notes: Standard reference quality baseline. Uniform compression error across document elements. Expected ELA result: LOW ANOMALY / baseline variance.

samples.modification_method: Single-pass headless browser render to bitmap, compressed once as JPEG at medium quality.
samples.evaluation_notes: Medium-quality single-pass web export baseline. Lower initial quality introduces higher baseline quantization noise, but remains uniform across all regions.

samples.modification_method: Localized patch splice: Base document compressed at Q=75; forged CGPA patch ('Cumulative CGPA of 9.95') compressed at Q=98; composite resaved at Q=85.
samples.evaluation_notes: Introduces physical quantization error mismatch between high-frequency patch and coarse background blocks. Expected ELA result: Elevated localized anomaly.

samples.modification_method: Dual-region splice: Base document compressed at Q=70; altered student name ('SYNTHETIC CANDIDATE ALPHA') and altered CGPA ('9.98') pasted from uncompressed raster; composite resaved at Q=90.
samples.evaluation_notes: Simulates adversary pasting clean text into a downloaded diploma. The uncompressed pixels undergo initial quantization while the surrounding image undergoes secondary recompression.

samples.modification_method: Double-compression block misalignment splice: Base document at Q=80; CGPA patch double-compressed at Q=60 then Q=95; composite resaved at Q=80.
samples.evaluation_notes: Introduces block boundary discontinuity and secondary compression harmonics over the CGPA numeric claim.
